newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tung Fong Hung to issue 250 mln new shrs.
newsitem.headline: Tung Fong Hung to issue 250 mln new shrs.

text.p: Tung Fong Hung (Holdings) Ltd said on Thursday its controlling shareholder Grandpoints Profits Ltd will privately place 157 million shares, or 12.44 percent of existing share capital, to professional investors at HK$0.40 per share and subscribe to 250 million new shares at the same price.
Crosby Securities (HK) Ltd is the placing agent.
On completion of the placement and subscription, Grandpoints' stake in the Chinese medicine retailer will remain unchanged at 37.29 percent, it said.
Net proceeds of HK$99 million from the new share subscription will be used to repay bank borrowings and for general working capital purpose, the company said.
Tung Fong Hung shares fell one cent to HHK$0.42 in morning trade.
